name: Georgsmarienhütte (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Georgsmarienhütte (a white lion on red).
history: Municipal flag of Georgsmarienhütte; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Georgsmarienhütte arms — white lion on red
